description: The longer you walk, the grass gets taller and the soil more moist. As the croaking of frogs fill the air, you stop and decide to take a look around.

effect: Place the volcano next to you and roll 1d6. On a 4 or above, the adjacent tiles are safe. On a 3 or lower, remove 1d6 resources from each adjacent tile. Phase 1 begins now, turn to page --- in the rulebook.

description: There's a sharp incline on the ground you walk. The air gets thin as you find yourself closer to its snowy peak.

description: You stumble across an opening in the hillside, seeing a faint glimmer inside you decide to investigate.

description: Things are looking a little rocky...
effect: Place a quarry, a cave, or a basin, and populate it.
